recipe.visualDefinition: A weathered, square album cover featuring a male portrait in an industrial setting, framed by a distressed off-white border with raw, handwritten-style typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center against a receding industrial perspective
High-contrast black leather jacket against a muted, desaturated background
Textured border framing the central image with simulated age and wear
Organic, loose handwriting contrasting with the rigid geometry of the background pillars
coreInvariants: Heavy distressing including scratches, dust, and corner wear
Desaturated color palette with cool blue and warm skin tones
Off-white header section for title and artist name

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, subject occupies the right two-thirds of the lower frame, leaning against a vertical structure.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes, which are positioned at the upper-right intersection of thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large handwritten name on the top left, moves across to the smaller title on the right, then drops down to the subject's face and follows the perspective lines of the pillars into the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper header and the left side of the image where the industrial hall recedes.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated greys and browns in the industrial background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black of the leather jacket providing a strong visual base.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale blue-white of the hoodie and subtle blue tones in the subject's eyes.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the dark jacket and the light header/hoodie.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to earth tones, blacks, and off-whites

letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width mimicking a felt-tip marker
Loose, non-connected characters with occasional ligatures
Irregular baselines and varying x-heights for an organic feel
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tall, thin 'M' and 'W' with sharp peaks
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Pairing a large, bold handwritten name with a smaller, thinner version of the same handwriting for the title.
graphicDevices: Thin horizontal rule separating the header from the image
Simulated paper texture and dust scratches
Faded 'Stereo' and technical markings in the top margin

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the raw, personal feel of the original lettering.
Alternative for a vintage, lo-fi aesthetic if script is not desired.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in a black leather jacket and white hoodie, leaning against a pillar in a desaturated, blurry industrial warehouse. Apply a heavy square frame with a thick off-white top border. Add layers of dust, scratches, and film grain across the entire composition.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom handwritten text in dark charcoal ink in the top border. Use a large, expressive script for the name on the left and a smaller, similar script for the title on the right.

verificationChecks: Is the texture sufficiently distressed and aged?
Does the handwriting look organic rather than a repeated font?
Is the color palette muted and cohesive?
Is the subject positioned correctly within the industrial perspective?

adjustableVariables: Degree of desaturation in the background
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Any brand logos in the corners

avoid: Clean, sharp edges on the border

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the scratches do not obscure the subject's eyes.
Check that the text remains legible despite the distressing.
Verify the 'Stereo' text at the top is faint and looks like old print.
Confirm the square aspect ratio is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Industrial portrait + Off-white header + Handwritten script + Heavy grunge overlay = Weathered Americana Aesthetic
